# Mobile App Landing Page: JUJU SELLER - Extreme Detail Breakdown


## **1. Complete Layout (Top-to-Bottom)**  
The landing page follows a **vertical, single-column layout** optimized for mobile viewing, with a dark, futuristic aesthetic. The structure is divided into 6 key sections:  

### **Section 1: Header (Top Navigation Bar)**  
- **Position**: Fixed at the top of the screen (covers 5% of viewport height).  
- **Content**:  
  - Left-aligned: App name "JUJU SELLER" in **bold, uppercase, light blue text** (hex: `#4FC3F7`).  
  - Right-aligned: Two elements:  
    - A green circular icon with a white "CHANNEL" label (hex: `#2E7D32` background, `#FFFFFF` text).  
    - A hamburger menu icon (three horizontal lines) in white (hex: `#FFFFFF`).  
- **Spacing**: 16px padding left/right, 8px padding top/bottom.  

### **Section 2: Hero Section (App Preview & Branding)**  
- **Position**: Below the header (occupies 25% of viewport height).  
- **Content**:  
  - **App Icon**: Centered, 80px square, rounded corners (radius: 12px), featuring a stylized anime character (white hair, dark outfit).  
  - **App Name**: "JUJU SELLER" – split into two parts:  
    - "JUJU" (bold, uppercase, white text, 24px font size).  
    - "SELLER" (bold, uppercase, light blue text, 24px font size).  
  - **Subtitle**: "FFASTUTECH OB 53" (light gray text, 14px font size, centered).  
  - **Tagline**: "Cara download, install, dan setup proxy server free terbaru – work 100%" (light gray text, 12px font size, centered, line height: 1.5).  
- **Spacing**: 24px between icon and name, 12px between name and subtitle, 16px between subtitle and tagline.  

### **Section 3: Status Cards (Key App Info)**  
- **Position**: Below the hero section (occupies 15% of viewport height).  
- **Content**: Three horizontal cards, centered, with 12px spacing between them. Each card has:  
  - **Status Card 1**:  
    - Left: "STATUS" (light gray text, 12px).  
    - Right: "ONLINE" (bright green text, 12px, bold).  
  - **Status Card 2**:  
    - Left: "BERHASIL DOWNLOAD" (light gray text, 12px).  
    - Right: "0" (white text, 12px, bold).  
  - **Status Card 3**:  
    - Left: "SERVER REGION" (light gray text, 12px).  
    - Right: "INDONESIA" (light blue text, 12px, bold).  
- **Card Design**: Dark gray background (hex: `#1E293B`), rounded corners (radius: 8px), 16px padding left/right, 12px padding top/bottom.  

### **Section 4: Timer (Live Status)**  
- **Position**: Below the status cards (occupies 5% of viewport height).  
- **Content**: Centered text "17:34:29" (white text, 14px font size, monospace font).  
- **Styling**: Subtle glow effect (light blue, hex: `#4FC3F7`) around the text.  

### **Section 5: Main Content (Placeholder)**  
- **Position**: Below the timer (occupies 40% of viewport height).  
- **Content**: Empty (intended for app screenshots, features, or testimonials).  
- **Styling**: Dark background (hex: `#0F172A`), with faint, scattered blue dots (hex: `#1E40AF`) for a "tech" aesthetic.  

### **Section 6: Footer**  
- **Position**: Fixed at the bottom of the screen (covers 10% of viewport height).  
- **Content**:  
  - **Left**: Copyright "© 2024 JUJU SELLER" (light gray text, 10px).  
  - **Right**: Three links: "Privacy Policy" (white text, 10px), "Terms of Service" (white text, 10px), "Contact" (white text, 10px) – separated by small dots (hex: `#64748B`).  
- **Spacing**: 16px padding left/right, 8px padding top/bottom.  


## **2. Color Scheme & Styling**  
- **Primary Background**: Deep navy blue (hex: `#0F172A`) – creates a dark, professional look.  
- **Accent Colors**:  
  - Light blue (hex: `#4FC3F7`): For "SELLER" in the app name, "INDONESIA" in status cards, and timer glow.  
  - Bright green (hex: `#2E7D32`): For "ONLINE" status and channel icon.  
  - White (hex: `#FFFFFF`): For primary text (app name, status values, footer links).  
  - Light gray (hex: `#64748B`): For secondary text (subtitle, status labels, footer copyright).  
- **Card Background**: Dark gray (hex: `#1E293B`) – contrasts with the main background.  
- **Typography**:  
  - **Font Family**: Inter (sans-serif) – clean, modern, and readable.  
  - **Font Weights**: Bold for headings (app name, status values), regular for body text.  
  - **Font Sizes**:  
    - App name: 24px (bold).  
    - Subtitle: 14px (regular).  
    - Tagline: 12px (regular).  
    - Status text: 12px (regular/bold).  
    - Timer: 14px (monospace, bold).  
    - Footer: 10px (regular).  


## **3. Card/Button Designs**  
- **Status Cards**:  
  - **Shape**: Rounded rectangle (radius: 8px).  
  - **Background**: Dark gray (hex: `#1E293B`).  
  - **Padding**: 16px left/right, 12px top/bottom.  
  - **Text Alignment**: Left (label) and right (value) – balanced layout.  
  - **Border**: None (flat design).  
- **Buttons (Not Shown, but Implied)**:  
  - **Download Button**: Would be a bright green rectangle (hex: `#2E7D32`), rounded corners (radius: 12px), white text ("Download Now"), 16px padding, 14px font size.  
  - **Learn More Button**: Light blue rectangle (hex: `#4FC3F7`), rounded corners (radius: 12px), white text ("Learn More"), 16px padding, 14px font size.  


## **4. Status Bars / Download Bars (Exact Content)**  
- **Status Bars**: Three horizontal cards (Section 3) with:  
  - **Status**: "STATUS" (label) + "ONLINE" (value, green).  
  - **Downloads**: "BERHASIL DOWNLOAD" (label) + "0" (value, white).  
  - **Server Region**: "SERVER REGION" (label) + "INDONESIA" (value, light blue).  
- **Download Bar (Implied)**: If present, would be a progress bar with:  
  - **Label**: "DOWNLOADING..." (white text, 12px).  
  - **Progress**: Gradient from light blue (hex: `#4FC3F7`) to green (hex: `#2E7D32`), 8px height, rounded ends.  
  - **Percentage**: "0%" (white text, 12px) on the right.  


## **5. Navigation Structure**  
- **Header Navigation**:  
  - **Left**: "JUJU SELLER" (app name, links to homepage).  
  - **Right**:  
    - "CHANNEL" icon (links to a community channel).  
    - Hamburger menu (opens a side drawer with links: Home, Features, Download, About, Contact).  
- **Footer Navigation**:  
  - "Privacy Policy", "Terms of Service", "Contact" (links to respective pages).  


## **6. Special UI Components**  
- **Carousel (Implied)**: For app screenshots (Section 5) – would have:  
  - **Arrows**: Left/right arrows (white, hex: `#FFFFFF`) with hover effect (opacity: 0.8).  
  - **Dots**: Three dots (white, hex: `#FFFFFF`) below the carousel, with the active dot (light blue, hex: `#4FC3F7`).  
- **Progress Bar (Implied)**: For download status – gradient from light blue to green, 8px height, rounded ends.  
- **Toast (Implied)**: For success/error messages – white background (hex: `#FFFFFF`), black text (hex: `#000000`), 12px font size, 16px padding, 8px border radius, appears at the bottom center.  


## **7. Footer Content**  
- **Left**: "© 2024 JUJU SELLER" (light gray text, 10px).  
- **Right**: Three links: "Privacy Policy" (white text, 10px), "Terms of Service" (white text, 10px), "Contact" (white text, 10px) – separated by small dots (hex: `#64748B`).  
- **Spacing**: 16px padding left/right, 8px padding top/bottom.  


## **Visual Hierarchy**  
- **Primary Focus**: App name ("JUJU SELLER") and icon (largest, boldest elements).  
- **Secondary Focus**: Status cards (key app info) and timer (live status).  
- **Tertiary Focus**: Tagline (descriptive text) and footer (legal links).  


This layout is designed to be **mobile-first**, with a focus on clarity, minimalism, and a tech-forward aesthetic. All elements are spaced to avoid clutter, and the color scheme ensures readability against the dark background.
